about: Hand-edited list of live cams for Surftracker (/sd/surf/cams). Surf cams only: every cam must show a surf break (owner rule, 2026-11-27; harbour and bay cams were removed). Only cams whose operators allow embedding: YouTube streams with embedding on, or a host's own Embed code (SkylineWebcams), checked 2026-11-27 (shared notes: surftracker-cams.md). Never add Surfline-owned cams, HDOnTap streams without permission, or Earth Watch Live until its ownership is confirmed. Fields: id (unique), name, kind ('surf'), area, youtube (video id; or source 'skyline' with skyline {id, page, image, embedHtml}: SkylineWebcams' own Embed code, used unmodified as their terms require), operator {name, url}, covers (spot ids in view: their break pages get a 'Live cam' link), near (nearest breaks, not in view), note (optional). src/surf/cams.py checks each cam daily and writes surf_cams_status.json.
